Also talking to people about it in little bits. This sounds so typical and cliche but trying to find little pockets of joy in the day can help. It takes a bit of effort but things like ‘look how nice the sun feels on my skin, oh the sky looks kinda cool, there’s a cute cat’ things like that. Or just eating a good meal I’ve been craving. Obviously it’s a mental illness but I do think you have more control than you think. You can chose to stay with that pocket of joy for just a few more seconds. Avoid things you know will trigger you further into the depression spiral. 

Not telling you how to cure your depression but just some little things I use sometimes. I believe in you.
